LaMelo Ball (Image Credits: X/@wsoctv) The Charlotte Hornets star LaMelo Ball has become the latest professional athlete to be involved in a car accident. Ball was reportedly part of a collision on Wednesday afternoon in Uptown Charlotte.
Footage from the scene showed Ball‚Äôs vehicle caught in a crash at an intersection . The impact force was strong enough to knock one of the wheels off. At the time of the accident, Ball was driving his customized 2022 Hummer and collided with a gray Kia sedan.
Following the crash, concerns quickly surfaced regarding Ball‚Äôs condition. However, subsequent video clips indicated that he appeared unharmed. He was seen stepping out of his Hummer without visible issues and later departed the scene in a Lamborghini.
According to reports, the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police Department traffic records confirm a crash occurred at approximately 4:07 p.m. The driver of the sedan was reportedly transported to the hospital with injuries that are not considered life-threatening.
LaMelo Ball‚Äôs Viral Driving Clips Raise Eyebrows Online LaMelo Ball (Image Credits: Imagn) Ball has drawn attention for the wrong reasons following the car accident. After the incident, a series of clips showing the Hornets star engaging in reckless driving circulated widely online, with many comparing his behavior to a scene from a video game like GTA.
Ball is now in his sixth season with the Charlotte Hornets. Despite a relatively quiet season statistically, the Hornets‚Äô head coach has praised Ball for his contributions that go beyond the numbers .
